status.unavailableHelp: Local Syncthing GUI/API could not be reached on 127.0.0.1:8384. Make sure syncthing.service is running.
transport.autoHint: Use LAN cable and Wi-Fi automatically, upgrading to LAN cable when plugged in
transport.ethernetHint: Sync exclusively over wired Ethernet and auto-pause when unplugged
transport.wifiHint: Sync exclusively over Wi-Fi and auto-pause when disconnected
transport.autoDesc: Automatically prefers wired Ethernet when available and falls back to Wi-Fi.
transport.ethernetDesc: Pinned to wired Ethernet. Synchronization pauses automatically whenever the LAN cable is unplugged.
transport.wifiDesc: Pinned to wireless network. Synchronization pauses automatically when Wi-Fi disconnects.
cable.detectedHelp: No DHCP address assigned. Enable Link-Local for direct PC-to-Notebook cable sync.
cable.activeHelp: Ready for direct PC-to-Notebook cable transfers. Restore DHCP when plugging back into a router.
bandwidth.wifiOnlyDesc: Run at full speed over a LAN cable and apply limits only while syncing on Wi-Fi.
settings.barRatesDesc: Display compact download and upload rates next to the bar icon during active transfers.
